verdict.rationale: Ollama's own documentation shows it serving as a backend for coding agents. It offers Anthropic Messages API compatibility so Claude Code can run on open models, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The `ollama launch` command sets up Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no config files. The GitHub README lists Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode as supported agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of coding-agent use in practice, and detail on which parts of the OpenAI API are covered (docs say only 'a subset').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models. No environment variables or config files needed.
connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as `Claude Code`, `OpenClaw`, `OpenCode` , `Codex`, `Copilot`,  and more.
Connect OpenAI clients to Ollama. Ollama supports a subset of the OpenAI API
Ollama lets you use open models with your coding agents so you can spend less while keeping your data private.
